websites.title: Websites
websites.description: Business websites to audit, e.g. https://www.example-dental.com. Domains without https:// work too.

datasetId.title: Or: Google Maps Scraper dataset ID
datasetId.description: Audit every business with a website from a Google Maps Scraper run. The business name, address, category and rating are kept in the output.

maxSites.title: Max websites
maxSites.description: Stop after this many websites (0 = no limit).

maxPagesPerSite.title: Pages per website
maxPagesPerSite.description: The homepage plus the contact, FAQ, pricing, booking and about pages it links to. More pages find more emails but take longer.

maxConcurrency.title: Websites in parallel
maxConcurrency.description: How many websites are audited at the same time. Lower it if many sites time out.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Usually not needed: business websites rarely block audits.
